Frequently Asked Questions
What is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?
paragraph
Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai is the first and only Trump-branded development in the Middle East, delivered by DarGlobal. It combines a five-star hotel, private residences, and a members-only club in a single address on Sheikh Zayed Road, with direct access to Downtown Dubai.
text
What unit types and sizes are available at Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?
The Trump Residences offer one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments and four-bedroom duplex penthouses, ranging from 109 to 722 sqm. Every unit is positioned to deliver a guaranteed view of either the Arabian Sea or the Burj Khalifa.
When will Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai be completed?
The project is under development with handover scheduled for December 2031. DarGlobal is the master developer. Buyers purchasing off-plan should contact the DarGlobal sales team directly for current payment plan terms and availability.
Where exactly is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai located?
The tower sits on Sheikh Zayed Road at the gateway to Downtown Dubai, giving residents direct access to Dubai Mall, the Dubai Fountains, and the Burj Khalifa district while bypassing the congestion of central Downtown.
Does Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai have the world's highest pool?
Yes. The development features the highest outdoor infinity pool in the world, reserved exclusively for residents of the Trump Residences. The rooftop pool overlooks the full Dubai skyline and is one of the project's defining headline amenities.
What is the Trump Members-Only Club?
The Trump Members-Only Club is a private club within the tower, accessible by annual membership fee with residents receiving priority access. It includes a signature bar, cigar lounge, golf simulator, spa treatment rooms, meeting rooms, and a dedicated pool.
What amenities are exclusive to residents of the Trump Residences?
Residents have exclusive access to the world's highest rooftop infinity pool, a state-of-the-art gym, an owners lounge, and a children's play area. Membership to the Trump Members-Only Club is available separately for access to the wider lifestyle facilities within the building.
Is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai a good investment?
The project sits in one of Dubai's highest-demand corridors, combining a globally recognised brand, a world-record amenity, and direct Downtown proximity. Branded residences in Dubai have historically commanded rental premiums over comparable unbranded units; buyers should seek independent advice on investment suitability.
How does Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai differ from other luxury towers in Dubai?
It is the only development in the Middle East to combine a Trump five-star hotel, a residents-only world-record infinity pool, and a private members club under one address. The hotel-residential structure gives owners access to hotel-grade services alongside private ownership.
How do I register interest or enquire about buying at Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?
Prospective buyers can register interest, download the project brochure, or book a private viewing through DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk. The sales team can confirm current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan details on request.

Frequently Asked Questions
What is The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin?
paragraph
The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin is a beachfront residential development on Al Marjan Island, Ras Al Khaimah, developed by DarGlobal. Aston Martin's design team applied the brand's precision and craftsmanship to each unit, producing a collection of one- to three-bedroom residences and three-bedroom beach villas directly on the water's edge.
text
What unit types and sizes are available at The Astera?
The Astera offers one-, two-, and three-bedroom residences and three-bedroom beachfront villas ranging from 61 to 265 sqm. All units feature Aston Martin-designed interiors and sit on Al Marjan Island with direct beach access.
What did Aston Martin design at The Astera?
Aston Martin's design team was responsible for the interiors of every residence, applying the brand's approach to precision, material quality, and artisanal craftsmanship to kitchens, bathrooms, and living spaces. The collaboration integrates cutting-edge design with the timeless finishes associated with the Aston Martin brand.
When will The Astera be completed?
The Astera is under development with handover scheduled for December 2028. DarGlobal is the master developer responsible for delivery on Al Marjan Island. Contact the sales team for current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan terms.
Where exactly is The Astera located?
The Astera is on Al Marjan Island, a man-made island off the Ras Al Khaimah coastline, 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. It sits approximately 5 minutes from the upcoming Wynn Resort on Al Marjan Island, the first casino resort in the Middle East.
What amenities does The Astera offer?
Amenities include direct beach access, an infinity pool, spa, sauna, pool bar, fitness centre, indoor cinema, yoga lawn, multipurpose hall, children's play area, and premium 24/7 security. Beach villas offer private access to the shoreline directly from the residence.
Is The Astera a good investment in Ras Al Khaimah?
Al Marjan Island is an emerging market where average apartment capital values rose approximately 35% in a single year. Branded residences historically command price premiums of 30 to 200% over comparable unbranded stock, and the Wynn Resort announcement has been directly linked to market price doubling over two years. Buyers should seek independent investment advice.
What is the UAE Golden Visa benefit for buyers at The Astera?
Buyers investing 2 million AED or more in UAE real estate may apply for a 10-year Golden Visa. The UAE applies 0% income tax and 0% property tax, providing a tax-efficient holding environment for both resident and international buyers.
How does the Wynn Resort affect Al Marjan Island property values?
The announcement of the Wynn Resort on Al Marjan Island, the first casino resort in the Middle East, has been directly linked to a doubling of market prices over the past two years. The resort will be approximately 5 minutes from The Astera and is expected to drive further tourism and rental demand for beachfront properties on the island.
How do I register interest or buy at The Astera?
Buyers can register interest, book a unit, or download the project brochure through DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk. The sales team can provide current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan details on request.

Albert Hall Mansions History
Albert Hall Mansions, nestled in the heart of London, is an iconic residential complex with a rich Victorian heritage. Designed by renowned architect Richard Norman Shaw, construction began in 1879 and concluded in 1886, marking a milestone in London’s architectural evolution. Among the city’s first luxury apartments, it catered to Victorian elites. Its red-brick façade, ornate terracotta details, and grand gables epitomize the Queen Anne revival style. Home to notable figures over the years, it remains a symbol of prestige and timeless elegance.

Frequently Asked Questions
What is Tierra Viva?
paragraph
Tierra Viva is a limited collection of ultra-luxury gated villas in Benahavís, Spain, developed by DarGlobal with design inspired by Automobili Lamborghini. Villas are staggered across the hillside at different levels in the Los Jaralillos district to ensure every home captures unobstructed panoramas of the Mediterranean Sea.
text
What is Automobili Lamborghini's involvement in Tierra Viva?
Automobili Lamborghini provided the design inspiration for Tierra Viva, with the project integrating the brand's approach to cutting-edge design, technology, and artisanal craftsmanship into villa architecture and interiors. The collaboration between DarGlobal and Lamborghini positions Tierra Viva as a convergence of performance culture and ultra-luxury residential living.
What villa sizes are available at Tierra Viva?
Tierra Viva offers a limited collection of villas ranging from 700 to 1,450 sqm. The collection is available in different villa configurations, including select units with an in-villa car lift. Contact DarGlobal for current unit availability and full specification details.
When will Tierra Viva be completed?
Tierra Viva is under development with completion scheduled for June 2028. Construction is actively underway, with progress updates available on the DarGlobal website. Contact the sales team for current payment plan terms and unit availability.
Where exactly is Tierra Viva located?
Tierra Viva is in the hills of Los Jaralillos, Benahavís, 15 minutes from Marbella and within easy reach of Puerto Banús and Sotogrande. The location gives direct access to 12 nearby golf clubs, Andalusian villages, and the shores of the Mediterranean, while remaining in one of the most prestigious residential areas on the Costa Del Sol.
What amenities does Tierra Viva offer?
Tierra Viva is a gated community with 24/7 premium security, an exclusive residents' clubhouse, sauna, steam room, and private pool areas. Select Painite villas include an in-villa car lift. The community is designed around the concept of seclusion and belonging rather than shared hotel-style facilities.
Can I obtain a Spain Golden Visa by purchasing at Tierra Viva?
Spain's Golden Visa programme is available to non-EU buyers making qualifying real estate investments. Given villa sizes and values at Tierra Viva, buyers should confirm current programme thresholds and eligibility with a qualified legal adviser, as Spain's Golden Visa rules have been subject to legislative review. DarGlobal can assist with introductions to legal professionals.
Why invest in Costa Del Sol real estate?
Spain is consistently ranked as offering among the highest real estate ROI in Europe, with low Eurozone interest rates between 3 and 5%, open regulations for foreign investors, and a robust tourism sector that supports rental returns. Benahavís specifically is one of the wealthiest municipalities in Spain and benefits from year-round Mediterranean climate and high-speed train connections to the wider coast.
What makes a Lamborghini-branded villa different from other luxury villas in Spain?
Branded residences at this tier consistently command significant price premiums over comparable unbranded stock. Tierra Viva combines the scarcity of a limited villa collection in Benahavís, one of Europe's most sought-after addresses, with a globally recognised automotive design brand. That pairing targets a very specific international buyer pool, which supports both value retention and resale appetite.
How do I register interest or buy a villa at Tierra Viva?
Buyers can register interest, browse the collection, or download the project brochure through DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk. The sales team can provide current villa availability, pricing, and payment plan details on request.

Albert Hall Mansions History
Albert Hall Mansions, nestled in the heart of London, is an iconic residential complex with a rich Victorian heritage. Designed by renowned architect Richard Norman Shaw, construction began in 1879 and concluded in 1886, marking a milestone in London’s architectural evolution. Among the city’s first luxury apartments, it catered to Victorian elites. Its red-brick façade, ornate terracotta details, and grand gables epitomize the Queen Anne revival style. Home to notable figures over the years, it remains a symbol of prestige and timeless elegance.

What is Marea, Interiors by Missoni?
paragraph
Marea, Interiors by Missoni is an exclusive branded residential community within the Finca Cortesin gated estate on Costa Del Sol, Spain, developed by DarGlobal. Missoni provided the interior design across the collection of two-, three-, and four-bedroom residences, which overlook the Mediterranean Sea and an elite golf course set against a 270-degree panorama.
text
What did Missoni design at Marea?
Missoni's design team was responsible for the interiors throughout the residences, bringing the Italian fashion house's signature approach to colour, pattern, and material quality into kitchens, bathrooms, and living spaces. The brand-led interiors give each residence a distinctive identity beyond standard luxury specification.
What unit types and sizes are available at Marea?
Marea offers two-, three-, and four-bedroom residences ranging from 223 to 553 sqm. The community is a gated complex within the Finca Cortesin estate, with each unit designed for the panoramic sea and mountain views the site commands.
When will Marea, Interiors by Missoni be completed?
Phase 1 of Marea completed in 2024. The full development is scheduled for completion in December 2027. The project is under development by DarGlobal. Contact the sales team for current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan terms.
Where is Marea, Interiors by Missoni located?
Marea sits within the Finca Cortesin gated estate in Cortesin, Costa Del Sol. The beach is 5 minutes away, Marbella is 20 minutes, Puerto Banús and Sotogrande are a 20-minute drive, Santa Maria Polo Club is 15 minutes, Gibraltar Airport is 45 minutes, and Malaga Airport is 50 minutes.
What is the 270-degree view at Marea?
The site's elevation and orientation give residences an unobstructed 270-degree panorama that stretches from Marbella along the Costa Del Sol coastline, across to Gibraltar, and continues to the mountains of Morocco on the African continent, with the Mediterranean Sea and Finca Cortesin golf course directly below.
What amenities does Marea, Interiors by Missoni offer?
Amenities include a gated community with private entrance and 24/7 premium security, 24-hour concierge, infinity pool, state-of-the-art gym, tennis courts, hanging observation deck, community garden, children's playground, children's swimming pool, children's splash area, and dedicated parking and storage per unit.
What is the Finca Cortesin estate?
Finca Cortesin is one of Costa Del Sol's most prestigious private estates, home to the five-star Finca Cortesin Hotel and Golf Club. Marea's location within this estate gives residents access to the exclusivity and security of one of Spain's most recognised luxury addresses on the Costa del Sol.
Why invest in Costa Del Sol property near Cortesin?
Costa Del Sol combines Spain's highest real estate ROI in Europe with Eurozone interest rates between 3 and 5%, a Mediterranean climate year-round, and strong tourism that supports rental demand. Cortesin's proximity to Marbella, Sotogrande, and Gibraltar positions it within a corridor that draws international buyers and second-home investors consistently.

paragraph
Les Vagues by Elie Saab is a branded seafront residential complex on Qetaifan Island North, Doha, developed by DarGlobal. Elie Saab provided the interior design for each residence and the building's common areas, bringing the Lebanese fashion house's signature aesthetic of cream, marble, bronze, and premium stone to one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments.
text
What did Elie Saab design at Les Vagues?
Elie Saab was responsible for the full interior design of each residence, as well as the building's lounges and lobby areas, personally selecting all furniture for the common spaces. The design palette centres on cream and grey tones, shiny metal finishes, bronze, marble, and premium stone, reflecting the couture-level craftsmanship the house is known for.
What unit types and sizes are available at Les Vagues?
Les Vagues offers one-, two-, and three-bedroom residences ranging from 86 to 389 sqm on Qetaifan Island North. Units are served by four personal elevators per building including a service elevator, and sit within a gated seafront complex with an infinity pool and landscaped sea-view courtyard.
When will Les Vagues by Elie Saab be completed?
Les Vagues is under development with completion scheduled for December 2027. Construction is actively underway on Qetaifan Island North. Contact DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk for current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan terms.
Where is Les Vagues located?
Les Vagues is on Qetaifan Island North, a 1.3 million sqm man-made island off the coast of Doha, Qatar. The development is 30 minutes from Hamad International Airport, within minutes of Qatar's largest theme park, and sits alongside 7 km of beach shoreline, a vibrant marina, and a signature 18-hole golf course and clubhouse.
What amenities does Les Vagues offer within the building?
Building amenities include an infinity swimming pool, state-of-the-art fitness centre, four personal elevators per unit including a service elevator, 24-hour reception, luxury retail, covered parking for all units, and a landscaped community courtyard with sea views. Lobby and lounge furniture was designed and personally selected by Elie Saab.
What lifestyle facilities does Qetaifan Island North offer?
Qetaifan Island North delivers 7 km of beach shoreline, private beaches, a marina, world-class boating facilities, boutique shopping, a water park, a winter garden, a signature 18-hole golf course and clubhouse, and 5-star hotels and amenities, functioning as a fully self-contained luxury destination in Doha.
Why invest in Qatar real estate?
Qatar offers a Golden Visa with an investment of $200,000, 0% property tax, 100% foreign business ownership, and one of the world's highest GDP per capita figures. Qatar hosted the FIFA World Cup 2022 and processes approximately 40 million tourists annually through Hamad International Airport, consistently rated the world's best.
Is Les Vagues by Elie Saab a good investment?
Les Vagues sits on a purpose-built island destination with a diversified lifestyle offering, in one of the Gulf's most politically stable and tax-efficient markets. Elie Saab-branded residences occupy a distinct position in Doha's luxury market, and branded product consistently commands a premium over comparable unbranded stock. Buyers should seek independent investment advice on suitability.
How do I register interest or buy at Les Vagues by Elie Saab?
Buyers can register interest, book a unit, or download the project brochure through DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk. The sales team can provide current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan details on request.

What is Trump International Hotel Oman?
paragraph
Trump International Hotel Oman is a luxury hotel at AIDA, Muscat, where investors purchase freehold ownership of individual rooms or suites. The hotel is managed by Trump Hotels, and owners earn a share of revenue from guest bookings while receiving two weeks of complimentary personal use each year.
text
What does owning a hotel room at Trump International Hotel Oman mean?
Owners hold freehold title to a specific room or suite within the hotel. Trump Hotels manages the property professionally, generating rental income from guest bookings. Owners receive a share of that revenue and retain two weeks annually for personal use, giving a tangible asset with managed returns.
What unit types and sizes are available at Trump International Hotel Oman?
The hotel offers rooms, junior suites, and suites ranging from 43 to 138 sqm. All units are managed by Trump Hotels as part of the hotel's operational inventory, ensuring professional management and a consistent stream of bookings.
When will Trump International Hotel Oman be completed?
Completion is scheduled for December 2028. The hotel is under development within the AIDA master community in Muscat. Contact DarGlobal for current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan details.
Where is Trump International Hotel Oman located?
The hotel is within AIDA, a master-planned destination in Muscat, rising 130 metres above sea level and 25 minutes from Muscat International Airport. AIDA includes a championship golf course, beach, night club, wellness centres, hiking and mountain bike trails, retail, and dining venues.
What are the benefits of hotel room ownership versus residential investment?
Hotel room ownership generates passive income from guest bookings, comes with full Trump Hotels professional management, and includes two weeks of complimentary personal use per year. Owners hold freehold title to a tangible hospitality asset without the management burden of private rental.
Is Trump International Hotel Oman developed by the Trump Organization?
No. The sub-developer is Dar al Arkan Property Development SPC, which uses the Trump name and mark under sublicense from DT Marks Oman LLC. The Trump Organization and its affiliates are not the owners, developers, or sellers of the property.
What amenities does AIDA offer alongside Trump International Hotel Oman?
AIDA features the Trump International Golf Club, Trump Member Club, Cliff Night Club, AIDA Beach, hanging suites, sky bar, all-day dining, swimming pools, wellness and fitness centres, hiking and mountain bike trails, a viewing deck, children's splash areas, parks, and promenades.
Why invest in Oman real estate?
Oman offers 0% personal income tax, 0% capital gains tax, 0% inheritance tax, 100% freehold ownership for all nationalities within Integrated Tourism Complexes, and lifetime residency visas for qualifying investors. Oman ranked 7th globally in the Numbeo Quality of Life Index 2023, with tourism projected to generate $22.5 billion by 2040.
How do I register interest or buy a hotel room at Trump International Hotel Oman?
Prospective buyers can register interest, explore available units, or download the brochure through DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk. The sales team can confirm current pricing, unit availability, and payment plan terms on request.

What amenities are available to Trump Cliff Villa owners?

How do Trump Cliff Villas relate to the wider AIDA development?

Albert Hall Mansions History
Albert Hall Mansions, nestled in the heart of London, is an iconic residential complex with a rich Victorian heritage. Designed by renowned architect Richard Norman Shaw, construction began in 1879 and concluded in 1886, marking a milestone in London’s architectural evolution. Among the city’s first luxury apartments, it catered to Victorian elites. Its red-brick façade, ornate terracotta details, and grand gables epitomize the Queen Anne revival style. Home to notable figures over the years, it remains a symbol of prestige and timeless elegance.

Frequently Asked Questions
What is Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?
paragraph
Marriott Residences Aida, Oman is a fully furnished branded apartment complex at AIDA, Muscat. The project is developed by Dar Al Arkan Property Development SPC, which uses the Marriott name under license from Marriott International. Residences come with à la carte hotel-style services and are designed to deliver the comfort and standard associated with the Marriott brand.
text
Who developed Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?
The project is developed by Dar Al Arkan Property Development SPC, which operates the Marriott brand name under a licensing agreement with Marriott International, Inc. Marriott Residences Aida, Oman are not owned, developed, or sold by Marriott International or its affiliates.
What unit types and sizes are available?
The development offers one-, two-, and three-bedroom fully furnished apartments ranging from 60 to 194 sqm. Each residence is designed with contemporary decor and thoughtfully furnished to offer stylish, comfortable living with seamless integration across all spaces.
What services do residents receive at Marriott Residences?
Residents benefit from à la carte services styled around the Marriott standard, including a dedicated concierge, 24-hour reception desk, doorman, lobby, and valet. The service model is designed to bring hotel-quality living to private residential ownership at the AIDA estate.
What amenities does AIDA offer for Marriott Residences owners?
The AIDA estate provides a championship golf course, swimming pools, a private beach enclave, children's splash areas, wellness centres, fitness centre, plazas, cafes and restaurants, hiking trails, mountain bike trails, running trail, promenades, viewing decks, parks, a clubhouse, outdoor landscapes, and access to nearby 5-star hotels including Nikki Beach, Al Bustan Palace Ritz-Carlton, Shangri-La, and Jumeirah Muscat Bay.
When will Marriott Residences Aida, Oman be completed?
Completion is expected in September 2029. The development is currently under construction. Contact DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk to register interest, book a unit, or download the project brochure.
Can foreign nationals buy property at Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?
Yes. Oman offers 100% freehold ownership for all nationalities on qualifying Integrated Tourism Complex (ITC) properties. Buyers on ITC-registered projects are eligible for a lifetime residency visa. An exclusive mortgage program is also available in Oman for both resident and non-resident buyers.
What are the tax advantages of investing in Oman?
Oman applies 0% personal income tax, 0% capital gains tax, and 0% inheritance tax, with inheritance assessed under the investor's own country's laws rather than local law. Businesses in special economic and free zones benefit from a 25-year exemption from corporate income taxes.
Why invest in Muscat real estate now?
Oman ranked 7th globally and 1st in Asia and the Arab world in the Numbeo Quality of Life Index in 2023, and is one of the safest countries worldwide. The country targets over $22.5 billion per year from tourism by 2040. The Saudi-Oman Highway cuts travel time by 16 hours between the two countries, and an upcoming railway project connecting the UAE to Muscat will further strengthen regional connectivity and investment appeal.
How does Marriott Residences relate to the wider AIDA development?
Marriott Residences is one of several residential products within the AIDA estate in Muscat. Other DarGlobal projects at AIDA include Trump International Hotel Oman, Trump Golf Villas, The Great Escape 2, and Sunrise Haven. Together they form a multi-branded, fully integrated resort community 130 metres above the Muscat Riviera.

Albert Hall Mansions History
Albert Hall Mansions, nestled in the heart of London, is an iconic residential complex with a rich Victorian heritage. Designed by renowned architect Richard Norman Shaw, construction began in 1879 and concluded in 1886, marking a milestone in London’s architectural evolution. Among the city’s first luxury apartments, it catered to Victorian elites. Its red-brick façade, ornate terracotta details, and grand gables epitomize the Queen Anne revival style. Home to notable figures over the years, it remains a symbol of prestige and timeless elegance.

Is Jeddah good for property investment?
Jeddah is one of Saudi Arabia's largest and most active real estate markets, driven by its status as a commercial hub and gateway city on the Red Sea coast. Demand for residential property in Jeddah is supported by a growing population, ongoing infrastructure investment, and ambitious national development plans under Saudi Vision 2030.
